questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “GPIO, interrupts, and debouncing”?
options: The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.

Keep the ISR short and handle work in the task or main loop.
questions.answer: Keep the ISR short and handle work in the task or main loop.
questions.explanation:
Keep the ISR short and handle work in the task or main loop.
Why: Configure GPIO on supported pins. Keep interrupt handlers short and timestamp events; debounce mechanical switches before treating each edge as a distinct press.
